item.title: SuprNation
item.description: SuprNation is a technology company founded in 2015 to serve as a home for some of the most competent and creative people in the iGaming industry. Their first product was launched in the summer of 2016, a casino determined to deliver a better user and gaming experience than what is currently available. SuprNation is a highly ambitious project with 4 casino brands, VoodooDreams, NYSpins, Duelz, and LosVegas live on the market.
